APPLICATION WITHHELD (BY SJE): Your application is on hold because your college has been put on hold. Please contact your institute or district office for further information.
APPLICATION WITHHELD (GOVERNMENT SERVANT: Your application is on hold because a family member is mapped as a government servant in your Jan Aadhaar. Visit the district office to remove the hold as per rules.
APPROVED BY DLO-SJE: Your application has been approved at the DLO level. Please keep checking your SSO ID for the latest updates.
OBJECTION BY DLO-SJE: An objection has been raised on your application. Resolve the objection, resubmit it to your institute, and get it forwarded to the district office as per rules.
OBJECTION BY INSTITUTE/ SCHOOL: An objection has been raised by your institute/school. Resolve it, resubmit your application to the institute, and get it forwarded to the district office as per rules.
OBJECTION BY VERIFIER-SJE: An objection has been raised by the verifier. Resolve it, resubmit your application to the institute, and get it forwarded to the district office as per rules.
OBJECTION CLARIFIED BY STUDENT: Your objection has been resolved and the application is pending at your institute. Please visit the institute and get it forwarded to the district office as per rules.
PENDING WITH DLO-SJE: Your application has been verified at the verifier level and is pending at the DLO level. Please check your SSO ID regularly for updates.
PENDING WITH INSTITUTE/ SCHOOL: Your application is pending at your institute/school. Please visit the institute and get it forwarded to the district office as per rules.
PENDING WITH VERIFIER-SJE/ DEO/ DSEO: Your application has been forwarded to the district office by the institute and will be verified soon. Please keep checking your SSO ID for updates.
REJECTED BY DLO-SJE: Your application has been rejected by the district office (SJE). Check your SSO ID or visit the district office to know the reason.
REJECTED BY INSTITUTE/ SCHOOL: Your application has been rejected by your institute/school. Check your SSO ID or contact your institute to know the reason.
REJECTED BY VERIFIER-SJE: Your application has been rejected by the verifier at the district office (SJE). Check your SSO ID or visit the district office to know the reason.
